# Rule 1.5 Intentionally using and/or abusing exploits, bugs, or external programs is not allowed. 
[color=lightgray]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/color] 

• If you discover a bug or glitch, you are expected to report it immediately and never intentionally use it again. 

• Examples of external programs consist of autoclickers, macros, cheat clients, et cetera. 

• Any form of cheating or exploiting will immediately result in a voucher ban.
